visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair and natural makeup sits in an indoor setting with a white door behind her. Another woman in a yellow cardigan stands behind her, smiling. The woman in front looks at the camera and moves her hand across the lens in a sweeping motion to create a transition effect. (2) The scene cuts to the same woman now featuring a glamorous transformation. She has voluminous wavy hair, bold red lipstick, and large gold heart-shaped earrings. She is dressed in a black low-cut gown and poses confidently against a plain white background, turning her body and glancing at the camera with various expressions. (3) The woman continues to pose, showcasing her styled hair and makeup from different angles. She places her hands near her neck and shoulders, highlighting her jewelry and the silhouette of her dress while the camera maintains a medium shot focused on her upper body.
